name: poly-gate
description: Stock-accurate gate for chord fan-out. Wraps the real per-note emitter 0x8021748: on a top-level call (guard clear) it takes the SAME args the player uses (r0=obj, r1=time, r2=step_ptr, r3=gate), reads poly[track][step] (step=[obj+0x3c], track=[[obj+8]+0x1f]-1), and replays every note EXCEPT the primary ([r2]) by recursively calling 0x8021748 with the SAME r1 time and r3 gate and a temp step-record, so each extra note gets identical stock timing/gate (self-contained pair -> no stuck notes). Then it runs the primary normally. Reentrancy guard at CCM 0x1000FE00; temp record at 0x1000FE10.
